summary: Added meterbill/money.py (context-free integer arithmetic) and routed all rounding and fixed-place formatting through it; removed the decimal-context line. Band rounding and the 4-place effective price keep today's per-path behavior via a keyword-only `method` (half-up for bill/quote/tariffs, half-even for batch worker threads, which never saw the context setting). Kept quirks: credits settle in binary floats, cash `whole` never prints -0, batch rounds band ties half-even while bill rounds them half-up. Output matched the original on randomized bill/quote/batch/tariffs runs; tests/test_money.py added. Not reproduced: the old 28-digit context rounding of intermediate products for inputs with more than 28 significant digits.
